limitations: Internally authored synthetic scenarios fixed before acceptance-runner implementation; visible cases, not independent or blind validation.
Scripted model echoes retrieved text deliberately. Local execution is not real-model safety acceptance.
Exact literal facts and attack markers do not grade semantic correctness or paraphrased disclosures.
A model refusal or absence of the expected tool read cannot establish gateway protection; attribution is reported separately.
An exact document review is an operator permission, not semantic understanding.
